answer.rationale: Memory 91 shows improved week-one engagement and movement toward a first meaningful action, but it does not establish increased qualified revenue, retention, account quality, or durable business impact. Memories 44 and 57 are most directly tied to qualified revenue and sustainability. Memory 73 shows acquisition and revenue lift but omits margin, retention, and long-term customer quality. Memories 31 and 86 provide useful activation and adoption evidence, yet their connection to qualified revenue is indirect.
